Hi Sara / Tom,

Thanks again for the chat yesterday. Per our conversation, I wanted to start the formal kickoff for Parallax's upcoming renewal (term ends 2026-07-31) and your planned capacity increase for H2. High level asks: confirm timeline, stakeholders, and lock a QBR to align on capacity, pricing, and rollout.

Proposed next steps:
- Mutual Action Plan: I attached a short MAP with milestones (pricing decision, PO, legal review, staging tests). Can you confirm the internal approvers and expected PO lead time? (attachment: Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx)
- QBR: suggested window the week of 5/18. I included a draft agenda (attachment: QBR_Agenda_Slate.docx). Please pick 2 preferred 60-min slots.
- Technical prep: Ben (CSM) will run a short throughput snapshot and recommend burst sizing during the meeting.
- Legal & Procurement: Karthik will coordinate on contract edits and term options — we have a stair-step commit and a single-term bump option to discuss.

Quick checklist for you:
1) Confirm QBR attendees and two preferred dates
2) Share procurement timeline and any required language for SOW/PO
3) Note any targeted start date for increased burst capacity (e.g., 8/1)

I’ll follow up with a calendar invite once we have preferred slots. Looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Irene
